title: NY RE Exam — Wayfinding Home
prompt:
Mobile home screen (iPhone, 393pt wide, dark mode) for "NY RE Exam", a personal cram app for the New York State real estate salesperson exam. Design concept "Wayfinding": the visual language of New York subway signage. Every syllabus topic is a colored circular route bullet with one bold character; progress is drawn as a line with station dots. Everything else is quiet, native-iOS polish on a dark OLED canvas.

Typography: Helvetica Neue bold for headings and all numbers (tabular figures, tight -0.02em tracking), system UI for body text. Sentence case everywhere. No all-caps labels, no middle-dot separators, no arrows on buttons.

Layout, top to bottom, 16px side gutters, 20px between sections:
1. Compact large-title header: "NY RE Exam" in 28px bold, small square app mark on the left.
2. Hero, the one bold moment: the exam countdown treated like an NYC subway platform arrival board. A 24-radius card (#111725) holding a near-black inset board (#05080f). Board header row: a round route bullet, then the destination "NYS salesperson exam" and, right-aligned, "Oct 14 & 15". Below, the countdown as three big tabular numerals set like a departures board, 44px Helvetica Neue bold, each in its own dark cell: "6" days, "07" hours, "05" minutes, with small lowercase unit words under each cell. Under the board one quiet line: "75 questions in 90 minutes, pass with 53 correct".
3. Readiness card (18 radius, #111725): a circular ring gauge on the left showing readiness 64% with a short white tick on the ring marking the 70% pass line; ring is amber (#f59e0b) while below 70%, green above; big "64%" in the centre with the word "ready" under it. On the right, three stat rows (label left in #a3b1c6, value right in white bold): Study streak "4 days", Questions seen "212 / 430", Accuracy "71%".
4. Resume card, shown only when a quiz is in progress: title "Resume quiz", secondary text "Study mode, question 7 of 10", a slim 4px line with 10 station dots (6 filled green, the current one ringed), and a compact "Resume" pill button on the right.
5. Actions: a full-width 56px tall green (#10b981) primary button with dark text "Quick 10-Question Drill". Below it two full-width secondary rows in #182033, 14 radius, left-aligned with a small icon on the left: "Mock 75-Question NYS State Exam" with secondary line "75 questions, 90 minutes, timed", and "Custom Quiz Builder" with secondary line "Pick topics, length and mode".
6. "Weakest lines" section: heading "Weakest lines" (20px bold). A grouped list (#111725, 18 radius, 1px hairline dividers) of 3 rows; each row: a 28px colored route bullet with one bold character (red #DA291C "2" Agency, blue #0039A6 "C" Estates & liens, yellow #FCCC0A with dark text "N" Taxes & assessments), the topic name, a thin accuracy bar under the name, and the accuracy right-aligned in red (#ef4444) because it is under 70% (48%, 55%, 62%). Directly under the list, a full-width tonal button "Retest Weak Areas" (dark raised fill, white text, not green).
7. Floating glass capsule tab bar: inset 12px from the screen edges and above the home indicator, fully rounded, translucent dark with backdrop blur and one soft shadow, 5 tabs with icon over label: Home (active, small green pill behind the icon, green label), Build, Stats, Mistakes, More.

Palette: canvas #090d16, surface #111725, raised #182033, hairline rgba(148,163,184,.16), ink #f1f5f9, secondary ink #a3b1c6, go #10b981, stop #ef4444, caution #f59e0b. Elevation by surface lightness, not shadows. Radius: 24 hero, 18 cards, 14 controls, full pills for bullets. Feel: calm, precise, native iOS, transit-signage clarity. Spend the boldness only on the arrival-board countdown.
